episode.tagline: Our power sector is stuck in an old world. Climate change and the needs of future generations demand that we shift from our traditional sources of power. But how?
episode.about: In this episode, Ajay takes us through the history of the power sector, the problems it faces, the remarkable progess in renewables, and the way forward. (Spoiler alert: the price system!) Amit expresses his enthusiasm for nuclear power, and busts the myths around it. Plug in now!
